# Vendored libraries

`qrcode.min.js` is qrcodejs 1.0.0 by Shim Sangmin (davidshimjs), MIT license,
https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs. It draws the QR code the iPad scans to join a
Class Pulse projector session. It is kept here, not loaded from a CDN, because the Class
Pulse page's content policy allows scripts only from this site and Google's sign-in hosts.
